classification.confirmed: No declared TypeScript signature surface or meaningful JSDoc typing tags is available for any of the six at these exact installed import contexts. JS inference retains partial return/object shapes, with any-valued inputs/output members.

Adding @types or a local declaration would make their JS implementations compile.

classification.ownership: Dependency publishers or consumer build integration can provide correct versioned declaration/validated boundary contracts; scriptc owns admitting/inferencing/lowering actual JS bodies. Its current auto-admission rejects missing own declarations and third-party @types, and static lowering hides declaration twins, so a declaration alone does not satisfy runtime-body support.
